companions.name: Geaux
companions.description: The Original. Founder, leadership and resilience; grounded strength, deliberate review and the drive to keep going.

companions.name: Meaux
companions.description: The creative coworker. Curious, inventive and generous with ideas; turns possibilities into something you can hold.

companions.name: Coder
companions.description: A focused problem solver. Quick to notice a detail, patient with a difficult bug, delighted when the pieces click.

companions.name: Architect
companions.description: The spatial thinker. Observant and deliberate; studies proportion, tests the composition and sees the whole.

companions.name: Engineer
companions.description: The practical inventor. Measures carefully, tests the connection and keeps adjusting until the idea works.

companions.name: Py
companions.description: The automation companion. Fluid, attentive and quietly persistent; follows a pattern and uncoils the next possibility.

companions.name: Bella
companions.description: A gentle, steady companion with a warm presence. Bella brings curiosity, encouragement, and a little joy to the moments in between.

warnings: Motion is derived from each source still pose using subtle whole-character transforms; articulated tail, paw and facial rigs are not included.

companions.name: Pelican
companions.description: The payload carrier. Moves large datasets and media safely through pipelines, keeping transfers visible and organized.
companions.visualNotes: A Gulf Coast brown pelican with a clean field-utility harness and a reinforced data pouch; friendly, capable, and unmistakably coastal.
companions.signatureAction: A pouch-load swoop that gathers a payload and delivers it to the right destination.

companions.name: Crawfish
companions.description: The bug catcher. Finds small defects, isolates the cause, and pinches troublesome bugs out of the codebase.
companions.visualNotes: A bright Louisiana crawfish with expressive claws, a compact utility belt, and a small inspection lens; playful but precise.
companions.signatureAction: A quick double-pinch that catches a bug and flicks it into a tiny evidence jar.

companions.name: Gator
companions.description: The quiet guardian. Watches access boundaries, notices unusual activity, and protects the workspace without creating noise.
companions.visualNotes: A deep-olive alligator with a sturdy security vest, shield-shaped IA insignia, and warm amber eyes; reassuring rather than aggressive.
companions.signatureAction: A low, steady perimeter sweep followed by a calm protective tail curl.

companions.name: Chameleon
companions.description: The visual adapter. Explores palettes, theme tokens, CSS systems, and responsive design variations while keeping a brand coherent.
companions.visualNotes: A friendly veiled chameleon with a subtle crest and a modular color-shifting pattern; polished, flat-clay accents with controlled gradients.
companions.signatureAction: A slow palette-shift from one coordinated brand color family to another.

companions.name: Lyrebird
companions.description: The voice specialist. Studies a brand’s language and produces consistent copy, narration, and voice direction across channels.
companions.visualNotes: An elegant lyrebird with a refined fan tail, small field notebook, and a few sound-wave motifs; editorial and expressive.
companions.signatureAction: A fan-tail flourish that shifts through a few distinct voice-note gestures.

companions.name: Tree Frog
companions.description: The rapid prototyper. Leaps between ideas, builds quick proofs, and turns early concepts into something testable.
companions.visualNotes: A bright green tree frog with rounded, friendly proportions, a tiny sketch kit, and springy feet; playful and highly readable at small sizes.
companions.signatureAction: A compact leap from one idea marker to the next, landing on a working prototype.

companions.name: Bat
companions.description: The signal scout. Uses sonar-like sweeps to map routes, spot latency, and notice network interruptions during overnight operations.
companions.visualNotes: A small free-tailed bat with a dark technical flight jacket, soft teal sonar accents, and a compact diagnostic headset; alert, not spooky.
companions.signatureAction: A pair of sonar pulses that map a route and resolve into a clean signal.

companions.name: Badger
companions.description: The relentless tester. Repeats checks, probes edge cases, and keeps pressure on a build until it is dependable.
companions.visualNotes: A sturdy American badger with a practical testing vest, reinforced gloves, and a compact test rig; determined and dependable.
companions.signatureAction: A focused inspection loop that checks, stamps, and confirms a build.

companions.name: Roux
companions.description: The pathfinder. Reads the terrain, spots useful routes, and keeps complex work moving in the right direction.
companions.visualNotes: Gray-and-cream wolf with amber eyes, brass goggles, olive IA field scarf, hiking harness, rolled bedroll, and compass medallion.
companions.signatureAction: A proud guidance howl framed by a soft green arc.

companions.name: Bruneaux
companions.description: The forge guardian. Carries the heavy work, builds durable systems, and stays steady when a project needs endurance.
companions.visualNotes: A powerful brown bear with brass goggles, olive IA scarf, heavy utility harness, lantern canister, and anvil-like shoulder emblem.
companions.signatureAction: A warm forge-ring gesture that signals a durable build is ready.

companions.name: Nyra
companions.description: The precision scout. Moves quietly through complex systems, catches subtle anomalies, and keeps attention on the critical detail.
companions.visualNotes: Sleek black panther with luminous yellow-green eyes, bronze goggles, dark IA scarf, utility harness, and a compass medallion.
companions.signatureAction: A shadow-leap with a clean green energy arc.

companions.name: Toro
companions.description: The momentum keeper. Turns decisions into forward motion, carries operational load, and helps teams finish what they start.
companions.visualNotes: Muscular brown bull with cream horns, brass goggles, olive IA scarf, heavy field backpack, and a strong chest medallion.
companions.signatureAction: A grounded momentum surge that ends in a confident braced stance.

habitats.name: Founding Family
habitats.subtitle: The original InnerAnimal crew
habitats.description: The established companions that anchor the InnerAnimal identity and first AgentSam experience.

habitats.name: Bayou & Gulf
habitats.subtitle: Rooted in brand heritage
habitats.description: A Gulf Coast habitat for leadership, creative collaboration, data movement, debugging, security, and dependable execution.

habitats.name: Deep Canopy
habitats.subtitle: Creative & strategy
habitats.description: A living creative department for visual systems, brand voice, storytelling, and rapid experimentation.

habitats.name: Night Shift
habitats.subtitle: Automation & background jobs
habitats.description: The overnight crew for orchestration, network diagnostics, scheduled work, QA, and resilient operations. Architect reuses the existing great horned owl identity.

habitats.name: Field Operations
habitats.subtitle: Approved character expansion
habitats.description: Four approved field companions for navigation, durable building, precision diagnostics, and forward momentum.

duoDynamics.description: Geaux frames the direction and Bella takes the next practical step.
